title: Lime Icebox Cake (Carlota de Limón)
changes_from_base: Maria biscuits layered with a no-cook lime and condensed milk cream and set in the fridge, instead of sponge and ice cream.
summary: Layers of soft biscuits soak in a tangy lime and condensed milk cream to create this simple, no-bake Mexican-style dessert, finished with lime zest and crumbs.
equipment: 1.6 litre glass dish or 20 cm square dish

ingredients.item: fresh lime juice, plus zest of 1 lime to serve

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 354 ml evaporated milk, 397 g condensed milk and 120 ml fresh lime juice together until combined and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Lay some of the 200 g Maria biscuits in one even layer in the dish, breaking pieces to fill any gaps and keeping a few crumbs back for the top.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Pour over just enough lime cream to barely cover the biscuits, pressing them under the surface.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Repeat the layers of biscuits and cream 3 or 4 times in total, finishing with enough cream to cover completely.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill for at least 4 h or overnight.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Scatter the reserved crumbs over the top along with the zest of 1 lime before serving.

tips: Whisk the milks and lime juice well so the mixture thickens evenly before layering.
Press the biscuits down into the cream so every layer soaks through completely.
Chill overnight if you have time, so the biscuits soften right through.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days.
